response: The tumour expression of VEGF is not associated with venous invasion in pT3 renal cell carcinoma. However, VEGF is an independent prognostic factor in this group of poor prognosis renal tumours, indicating that it has a significant impact on survival. In other words, while VEGF expression does not directly influence the progression of the tumour into the renal vein and vena cava, it is still a crucial factor in determining the overall survival of patients with pT3 renal cell carcinoma.
